capabilities: Classify images in the vault through a dedicated interface
Assign existing Obsidian tags to images
Create embedded notes from images via right-click
Browse curated images in visual galleries without writing code or queries
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no dedicated tools for classifying, tagging, and visually browsing image assets inside a vault.
summary: Image organization plugin that lets you classify vault images through a GUI, tag them with existing Obsidian tags, and browse them in visual galleries.
